name: Ivy-leaved Duckweed
desc: Ivy-leaved Duckweed (Lemna trisulca): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 11 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Lemna trisulca L. (syn. Staurogeton trisulcus (L.) Schur; star duckweed; ivy-leaved duckweed) is a species of aquatic plants in the arum family Araceae.
